'''2009 Worlds Day 3 Ian W. LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ian W.]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This]]
* '''Username:''' Ghosttrain
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
